context: Can you give me two different formal alternatives to "What's up? I'm going to the beach today" and do not use any commas in your response.

trace.content:
I am pleased to inform you that I will be visiting the beach today.
Please be advised that my plans for the day include a trip to the beach.
I am pleased to inform you that I will be visiting the beach today. Please be advised that my plans for the day include a trip to the beach.
